messages:
alex: Quick pair review request — PR #5421 touches token-proxy + vpc-egress whitelist. Planning to merge in today's 18:00 UTC slot. Can someone from sec take a quick look for secret leakage / KMS scope? :eyes:

jamie: link plz

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5421
alex: Summary: we moved logic that was env-only into a small per-tenant config. The diff that matters:
```diff
- TENANT_SECRET=fetch_from_vault()
+ TENANT_SECRET=${TENANT_SECRET} # now injected by sidecar via projected secret
+ VPC_EGRESS_ALLOWED_CIDRS=["10.5.0.0/16"]
```
alex: No code writes secrets to logs AFAICT — added a log guard, but want sec confirmation.

sec-bot: Static scan: 1 medium finding — "env var fallback may cause secret to be logged in debug mode". See report: https://sec-reports/internal/AUD-2026-11-5101
sec-bot: Recommendation: ensure redact on DEBUG and rotation on deploy.

priya: Are we changing KMS keys or policies? That touches HSM rotation plan.

alex: No KMS changes; we use existing tenant key. But we did add an optional KMS-URI env for on-prem customers; default is empty.

morgan: I can do a quick review. Please paste the small snippet of the sidecar container spec and the projected volume config.

alex: pasted:
```yaml
containers:
  - name: token-proxy
    env:
      - name: TENANT_SECRET
        valueFrom:
          secretKeyRef:
            name: tenant-cred
            key: token
volumeMounts:
  - name: tenant-secret
    mountPath: /var/run/creds
volumes:
  - name: tenant-secret
    projected:
      sources:
        - secret:
            name: tenant-cred
            items:
              - key: token
                path: token
```

morgan: Looks ok. Two asks:
- remove any accidental `console.log(process.env.TENANT_SECRET)` or debug prints — grep+CI to ensure
- ensure `readOnly: true` on mount. Add `readOnly: true` to the volumeMount.

sam: I'll run local e2e and smoke tests. If green, I can LGTM and coordinate merge at 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup: 

priya: Also request: canary for 2 pods in prod for 30 mins before full rollout? If tests pass we do that.

alex: Can do. I'll add canary flag and rollout plan in PR description.

morgan: Also add a short "post-deploy rotation" checklist in PR linking to ops-runbook (rotation window, who to ping) — small step but helps.

alex: done — PR updated with runbook link and added readOnly fix. Marking for sam + morgan review.

sam: e2e passed locally, smoke in staging queued. Assigning myself to merge slot. ping @oncall if any infra blips.

sec-bot: Note: redeploy will trigger creds audit. Audit ID: AUD-2026-11-5101

morgan: :shipit: pending staging smoke. If staging okay, please schedule canary as priya asked.

alex: Thanks all. I'll wait for staging smoke and then we can merge at 18:00 UTC. Will post final merge here. :calendar:
